title: Malformed metadata in summer_1am wallpaper causes repeated qt.imageformats.tiff ImageLength warnings
line: The summer_1am wallpaper no longer makes Dolphin and the wallpaper picker print a burst of "TIFF directory is missing required ImageLength" warnings.
explanation: The EXIF data of both summer_1am JPEGs (the 2560x1600 image and screenshot.jpg) describes the embedded thumbnail with Compression=0, which is not a valid value, although the thumbnail itself is a normal JPEG. Readers then treat it as an uncompressed TIFF thumbnail without dimensions, and Qt's TIFF plugin warns about the missing ImageLength each time the file's thumbnail or metadata is read. The change sets that one EXIF field to 6 (JPEG) in both files; the picture, the thumbnail and all other metadata, including the license comment, are untouched.

commits.message:
summer_1am: fix invalid compression tag of the EXIF thumbnail

Both summer_1am JPEGs declare their EXIF thumbnail with compression 0,
which is invalid, so image readers parse it as TIFF and repeatedly warn
about a missing ImageLength field. Mark it as the JPEG (6) it really is.

BUG: 524594

patches.diff:
diff --git a/summer_1am/contents/images/2560x1600.jpg b/summer_1am/contents/images/2560x1600.jpg
Binary file summer_1am/contents/images/2560x1600.jpg changed
diff --git a/summer_1am/contents/screenshot.jpg b/summer_1am/contents/screenshot.jpg
Binary file summer_1am/contents/screenshot.jpg changed

media.caption: Pure master: dolphin --select on summer_1am's 2560x1600.jpg prints 9 TIFF ImageLength warnings
Patched file, same command: no warnings
The patched summer_1am set as the desktop wallpaper still displays normally

review.text: Targeted, exact root-cause fix in plasma-workspace-wallpapers that corrects the invalid EXIF IFD1 thumbnail Compression tag from 0 to 6 (JPEG) in both summer_1am JPEGs without altering decoded pixels, the embedded thumbnail, or license comments. Before/after verification cleanly proves the TIFF ImageLength warnings disappear and the wallpaper still renders properly.

reviews.text: Targeted, exact root-cause fix in plasma-workspace-wallpapers that corrects the invalid EXIF IFD1 thumbnail Compression tag from 0 to 6 (JPEG) in both summer_1am JPEGs without altering decoded pixels, the embedded thumbnail, or license comments. Before/after verification cleanly proves the TIFF ImageLength warnings disappear and the wallpaper still renders properly.

The cause is in the asset itself: IFD1 Compression=0 in both summer_1am JPEGs, the only malformed wallpaper. Fixing it in plasma-workspace-wallpapers is the right place. I checked the commit: exactly one byte changes in each file (offset 162, 0 to 6). Decoded pixels are identical, the license comment is kept, and the thumbnail now decodes as a JPEG. The Dolphin logs go from 9-11 warnings to 0 and the wallpaper still renders. The commit message matches the change.
